The benefit of the favorable pricing environment during the 2026 quarter was partially offset by hedging-related charges, including approximately $9.8 million of unrealized mark-to-market charges associated with open derivative positions intended to mitigate the Company's exposure to future fluctuations in metals prices.

The Company believes that its current cash position along with cash flows from operations and borrowing capability due to its financial position are adequate to fund its expected cash requirements for the next 12 months.
Hedging decisions are intended to protect the value of the Company's inventory and produce more consistent financial results over price cycles.

The Company recognized a hedging related charge of approximately $17.4 million during the six months ended September 30, 2026 which includes approximately $10.5 million of unrealized mark-to-market charges associated with open derivative positions intended to manage future metals price exposure.
